Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. These suggestions can change posted F and S.

What looks good:

- The six existing material rows keep their values and diameter scaling.
- The new material words agree across the app, CLI and MCP descriptions.
- The router tests detect both mutations that I repeated.
- The process change has `Process change: yes`. It does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Results merged with main:

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3158`.
The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `ebf66f3840848555de97e07aa810f86016b69f79` was clean.
`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 24 steps.
The app test targets built with `--no-run` before the suites ran.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-tools --test headless_bin --test unknown_row`: 3 and 6 tests passed.
- The diff changes no fixture directory or importer. The extra kernel STEP and mesh suites do not apply.

Clippy:

- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Mutations repeated locally:

1. Force `WorkMaterial::chip_scale` to use `fz_scale`: 3 of 5 router tests failed. After restoration, all 5 passed.
2. Use the full V-bit diameter for chip load: the V-bit test failed. After restoration, all 5 passed.

Both mutations were temporary. The worktree has no code changes after restoration.
The PR changes no goldens. I checked the unchanged metal rows and their scaling branch in the diff.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/cutting.rs:209` and `crates/tools/src/cutting.rs:124`: Supply the required heavy-lane results.
   `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches every `motion` and `app` heavy target: 237 steps.
   These lanes were not run in this review. The PR body gives no results for them.
   Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Add the lane results to the PR body.
   Current upstream [AGENTS.md, lines 628-636](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/ebf66f3840848555de97e07aa810f86016b69f79/AGENTS.md#L628-L636) requires these results before the PR is ready.

Notes:

The diff changes no `crates/ui` file. The before/after screenshot check does not apply.
The review used current upstream laws, not the PR branch's copy.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the one requested change of the review on `a022f26da77172be7524d3bf7dab8ac8de98ed84`.

1. Heavy-lane results (`crates/app/src/cutting.rs:209`, `crates/tools/src/cutting.rs:124`):
   - I ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the head `a022f26da77172be7524d3bf7dab8ac8de98ed84`.
   - Result: 236 steps, 0 failed, wall 44.3 min.
   - `motion` heavy lanes: 37 steps green. `app` heavy lanes: 198 steps green. Step 1 is the release build.
   - The known-fail markers for #1950 and #2849 stayed red as expected.
   - The PR body now has these results, in a "Heavy lanes" paragraph under "Tests".

The finding asked for results only. No code changed, so the head stays `a022f26da77172be7524d3bf7dab8ac8de98ed84`. The quick gate result in the review stays valid for this head.

Please review again.
